documents.subject: Invoice AP-00788 review request
documents.body:

documents.body: Follow-up for Granite Legal 008 and Casey Team05: Please review the open clarification request for AP-00788. The packet links the posted invoice to VEN-008, PO-00788, VA-AP-00788, and service receipt RC-AP-00788. Each recorded amount is $2,338.55, and the receipt identifies EMP-005 as the accepting party.
